g.title: IGN_SWITCH_START
g.text: +12V present ONLY when key is held to START position (Kl.50). Connects to EWS2 pin 1 (and via bypass bridge to pin 3) and to HARNESS_12PIN pin 6 (STARTER_TRIGGER to MaxxECU).

g.title: EWS_BYPASS_BRIDGE
g.text: Short jumper wire bridging EWS2 connector pins 1 and 3

g.title: STARTER_SIGNAL
g.text: Ignition switch START output to MaxxECU 12-pin extra pin 6 (F). Routed from cabin ignition lock area through firewall grommet to engine bay.

g.title: EWS2_MOD
g.text: EWS2 Module Connector (4-pin, gray, behind glovebox)

MODIFICATION: short pins 1 and 3 (bridge IGN_15 to STARTER_ENABLE); remove or cut pin 4 (isolate IMMO_KLINE). The EWS2 module body can remain in place or be removed. Remove the ring antenna from the ignition lock ring if EWS2 module is physically removed.

g.title: HARNESS_12PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 12-pin extra connector (REV2)

This connector is on the purchased M50 pre-terminated harness. Pins 1 (A), 2 (B), 3 (C), 4 (D), 7 (G) are connected to the power distribution relay board (Phase 1 discrete relay setup). Pin 6 (F): starter trigger signal to MaxxECU. Pin 12 (M): alternator D+ — connect via charge bulb to IGN+.

g.title: CHARGE_BULB
g.text: Inline between +12V IGN (fused 5A) and 12-pin pin 12 (ALT_D_PLUS). Illuminates as battery warning when alternator is not charging; extinguishes once alternator output exceeds IGN supply voltage. Can route through OEM instrument cluster battery bulb holder if desired.

g.title: ALT_EXCITE
g.text: Alternator D+ excite: from charge bulb ALT_SIDE to 12-pin pin 12 (M). Engine-bay-side only; charge bulb and IGN source wire are cabin-side.
